{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent downward bias that increases with longer horizons as true prices mean-revert from model over-optimism",
    "Sentiment turns positive ( > 0.5) only when prices are near local minima, creating a lag where model forecasts remain too low relative to the imminent price recovery",
    "When sentiment becomes negative ( < 0), model forecasts overshoot above current reality, failing to account for the slow price adjustment to fundamental constraints",
    "The forecast error systematically widens from day 10-20 in the 30d horizon as true prices continue mean-reverting while model projections become increasingly detached",
    "Model uses sentiment as a linear offset from historical averages, but actual price responses to sentiment shifts are non-linear and delayed, creating systematic underperformance during sentiment-driven movements",
    "When price history shows high volatility (std > 3), model forecasts over-smooth the trajectory, producing outcomes that are consistently too far from the actual volatile path",
    "Sentiment alignment with price direction reverses after day 15 in the forecast horizon as model projections become unrealistic, causing early forecast accuracy to decouple from sentiment-based corrections" ]}
